_doc: How door and window tags, floor level marks and the north arrow are drawn. Drawing conventions only, not design rules. tagUnit / tagDecimals: unit and decimals of the sizes in a tag ('cm', 'm' or 'mm'). A door tag reads width/height (90/210); a window tag adds its sill height after sillPrefix (120/140 p=90). The sizes below are millimetres on paper; on screen the plan is treated as if drawn at the screenScale of dimensionStyle.json. tagTextHeightMm: height of tag lettering. tagGapMm: gap between a tag and the wall face. levelTextHeightMm: height of the floor level figure. levelSymbolMm: width of the triangle beside it. levelOffsetMm: how far above the room label the level mark sits. northArrowMm: length of the north arrow.
